title: Carl Benz: He Built the First Car, His Wife Took It on the Road | Born 182 Years Ago Today

lines: He built the first car, and his wife took it on its first long trip.
Who changed the world today? November 25.
Who changed the world today? November twenty-fifth.
On this day in 1844,
On this day in eighteen forty-four,
in Karlsruhe, Germany,
Carl Benz, inventor of the car, was born.

data.hook:
He built the first car.
His wife drove it away.
data.name: Benz

lines: His father, a train driver, died when Carl was two.
His mother saved every coin to keep him in school.
At fifteen, he entered the technical college,
dreaming of a carriage that moved without horses.
His business struggled and money ran short,
so his wife Bertha put in her dowry.
On New Year's Eve 1879, his engine finally roared to life.
On New Year's Eve, eighteen seventy-nine, his engine finally roared to life.
In 1886, his three-wheeled motor car got its patent.
In eighteen eighty-six, his three-wheeled motor car got its patent.
But people laughed at it, and few wanted one.
In August 1888, Bertha took their two teenage sons,
In August eighteen eighty-eight, Bertha took their two teenage sons,
and without telling Carl, drove to her mother's,
from Mannheim to Pforzheim, about a hundred kilometres.
Out of fuel, she bought a cleaning solvent at a pharmacy.
When a fuel line clogged, she cleared it with her hatpin.
That evening, she arrived safely and sent Carl a telegram.
Now all of Germany knew: the horseless carriage worked!
Carl Benz died in 1929, at eighty-four.
Carl Benz died in nineteen twenty-nine, at eighty-four.
Today, over a billion cars fill the world's roads,
all starting from that little three-wheeler.
Their question for you:
If no one believed your idea, how would you make them see?
If no one believed in your invention, how would you make them see?
